command: swift test --package-path AirframeCore && swift test --package-path AICockpit; xcodebuild -workspace Airframe.xcworkspace -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS' test -only-testing:AgileCockpitTests
environment: Local macOS development workspace; direct canonical evidence fallback used because AICockpit evidence attach does not support the canonical backend (SP-044 T-0185 through T-0189 address this).
summary: Added a lifecycle guard in gapDiagnostics so proposed and draft requirements no longer emit missingImplementationTrace or missingVerificationEvidence; missingReleaseScope is unchanged. Added test requirementGapDiagnosticsSkipNotYetStartedRequirements asserting proposed and draft are suppressed while active and implemented are still reported, and updated two assertions in requirementTraceabilityIndexAndGateEvaluationCoverWorkItemsEvidenceAndReports that encoded the previous behavior. Also moved warning surfaces out of the Requirements and Tests tabs into a dedicated Warnings section and replaced the Release Gate blocking-reason list with a count. Measured in JustTone: requirementGapRows 261 to 0, blockingReasons 494 to 233, total 755 to 233. The remaining 233 are openBlockingReasons, a separate release-gate check left deliberately in place. AirframeCore passed 103 tests, AICockpit passed 58 tests, and the AgileCockpit unit tests passed.
